description:
In a world where architecture, gaming technology, and virtual production intersect, the future belongs to versatile storytellers. Mengyi Fan, director of visualization, highlights how SHoP Architects is embracing real-time interactive 3D while maintaining the humanity of the built environment. 

Learn more about the collaborative nature of SHoP’s visualization team and their diverse backgrounds, and how tools like VR, AR, and pixel streaming are transforming the way architecture is designed, experienced, and shared with the public.

Behind every jaw-dropping live show is a powerful real-time team driving the visuals. In this episode of Career Connections, Jonathan Masterson of Silent Partners Studio shares how Unreal Engine is transforming broadcast, theatre, and live concerts productions into fully immersive experiences. 

From innovative theatrical projects like La Haine to cutting-edge live shows, Jonathan reveals how creativity, technical precision, and curiosity drive the future of entertainment and explains why staying adaptable is the ultimate career advantage.
